title: Do Compact SSL Backbones Matter for Audio Deepfake Detection? A Controlled Study with RAPTOR
abstract: arXiv:2603.06164v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) underpins modern audio deepfake detection, yet most prior work centers on a single large wav2vec2-XLSR backbone, leaving compact under studied. We present RAPTOR, Representation Aware Pairwise-gated Transformer for Out-of-domain Recognition a controlled study of compact SSL backbones from the HuBERT and WavLM within a unified pairwise-gated fusion detector, evaluated across 14 cross-domain benchmarks. We show that multilingual HuBERT pre-training is the primary driver of cross-domain robustness, enabling 100M models to match larger and commercial systems. translated_title: 紧凑型SSL骨干网络对音频深度伪造检测重要吗？基于RAPTOR的受控研究
translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）是现代音频深度伪造检测的基石，然而以往研究大多聚焦于单一的大型wav2vec2-XLSR骨干网络，对紧凑型模型的研究则较为匮乏。我们提出了RAPTOR（Representation Aware Pairwise-gated Transformer for Out-of-domain Recognition，用于域外识别的表示感知成对门控Transformer），这是一项在统一的成对门控融合检测器框架下，对来自HuBERT和WavLM的紧凑型SSL骨干网络开展的受控研究，并在14个跨域基准上进行了评估。结果表明，多语言HuBERT预训练是跨域鲁棒性的主要驱动因素，使1亿参数规模的模型能够匹敌更大规模及商业系统。除EER之外，我们还引入了一种结合基于扰动的偶然不确定性的测试时增强协议，以暴露标准指标无法察觉的校准差异：WavLM变体在扰动下表现出过度自信的错误校准，而迭代训练的mHuBERT则保持稳定。这些发现表明，关键在于SSL的预训练轨迹，而非模型本身……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出RAPTOR检测器，通过受控实验证明多语言HuBERT预训练（而非模型规模）是紧凑型SSL骨干网络实现跨域音频深度伪造检测鲁棒性的关键，并引入基于扰动的测试时不确定性增强协议，揭示了WavLM过度自信而mHuBERT校准稳定的差异。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled study with the proposed RAPTOR pairwise-gated fusion detector, this paper demonstrates that multilingual HuBERT pre-training—rather than model size—is the primary driver of cross-domain robustness for compact SSL backbones in audio deepfake detection, and introduces a perturbation-based test-time augmentation protocol with aleatoric uncertainty that exposes calibration differences invisible to standard metrics.
